name: Synergy Group Fitness — Design Tokens

bone.comment: Primary text on dark / light elements

bone-section.comment: Light section backgrounds (warmer than bone text)

electric.comment: Accent — CTAs, active states, highlights ONLY

colorRules: Dark theme is the default; bone (#EDE8DF) sections are used to break rhythm — never more than 1-2 per page
Electric blue is reserved for interactive elements, key accents, and one typographic highlight per view — never large fills except the final CTA band
No gradients as backgrounds except directional dark scrims over imagery

display.usage: Headlines, numerals, buttons — always uppercase, bold

mono.usage: Kickers, labels, meta, stats — uppercase with wide tracking

typeScale.h2: text-4xl md:text-6xl / Oswald 700 / uppercase / tracking tight
typeScale.kicker: text-xs / JetBrains Mono / uppercase / tracking 0.3em / electric blue

space.rule: Extreme vertical rhythm — more air than feels comfortable

border.radius: 0 — sharp corners everywhere; no rounded cards or pills

effect.grain: Fixed full-viewport SVG fractal-noise overlay, opacity 0.16, mix-blend overlay, pointer-events none
effect.photoTreatment: Electric blue tint overlay (#4C63F5 at 20%, mix-blend color) that fades to 0 on hover + image scale 1.05, 700ms ease-out
effect.cornerBracket: 10x10 top-left corner mark, 2px top+left border in electric blue, on framed imagery
effect.glassNav: bg #121212 at 70% + backdrop-blur-xl + bottom hairline, only when scrolled

patterns: Masked line-by-line headline reveal (overflow hidden, y 115% → 0, staggered 140ms)
Scroll-triggered fade-up: opacity 0 + y 40-60 → visible, viewport margin -10%
Marquee: 55s linear infinite, alternating solid/outline type
Parallax: y ±10-22% tied to section scroll progress
Custom cursor: 8px dot (mix-blend difference) + spring ring (stiffness 250, damping 25) growing to 56px on interactive hover
motion.reducedMotion: Disable Lenis, marquee, and reveals when prefers-reduced-motion

component.buttonPrimary: Sharp rectangle, electric bg, bone text, Oswald uppercase, hover bg #3B4CE0, ArrowUpRight icon that translates on hover
component.buttonGhost: 1px hairline border, transparent bg, hover border+text electric
component.cardGrid: Border-collapse grids with visible 1px hairlines; hover flips to inverse (dark↔bone)
component.indexLabel: JetBrains Mono '/01' style numerals in electric blue on cards and frames
